chapter: War years, Decca records and La Conga
title: Replacing Noro Morales at the China Doll
summary: When La Conga became the China Doll, Machito's band filled in two weeks for Noro Morales.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Now, I know that the La Conga Club became the China Doll in September, 1946. Did you ever play at the China Doll?
We did ahh - Noro Morales was at the China Doll.
Yeah. He opened up the club.
He opened up the China Doll, but he went to Venezuela for two weeks and we replaced Noro Morales those two weeks.
Did you record then, over the radio, while you were there for those two weeks?

Yes, because the running was like a steady thing, because Noro Morales, through Jack Robbins, he had the same connections, WOR and NBC. They was the stations that was broadcasting coast to coast, so he had the, you know, the connection to have a radio time from La Conga.
